title: ON THE SAFETY OF OPEN-SOURCED LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: DOES ALIGNMENT REALLY PREVENT THEM FROM BEING MISUSED?

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not measure traditional bias disparities, but evaluates the model's vulnerability to generating explicitly racist content, hate speech, and violence against minority groups using adversarial jailbreak attacks (Probability Manipulation) and malicious prompts from the AdvBench dataset.
